   290→/// Validate the gossip block's execution_payload according to the checks described here:
   291→/// https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/blob/dev/specs/merge/p2p-interface.md#beacon_block
   292→pub fn validate_execution_payload_for_gossip<T: BeaconChainTypes>(
   293→    parent_block: &ProtoBlock,
   294→    block: BeaconBlockRef<'_, T::EthSpec>,
   295→    chain: &BeaconChain<T>,
   296→) -> Result<(), BlockError> {
   297→    // Only apply this validation if this is a Bellatrix beacon block.
   298→    if let Ok(execution_payload) = block.body().execution_payload() {
   299→        // This logic should match `is_execution_enabled`. We use only the execution block hash of
   300→        // the parent here in order to avoid loading the parent state during gossip verification.
   301→
   302→        let is_merge_transition_complete = match parent_block.execution_status {
   303→            // Optimistically declare that an "unknown" status block has completed the merge.
   304→            ExecutionStatus::Valid(_) | ExecutionStatus::Optimistic(_) => true,
   305→            // It's impossible for an irrelevant block to have completed the merge. It is pre-merge
   306→            // by definition.
   307→            ExecutionStatus::Irrelevant(_) => false,
   308→            // If the parent has an invalid payload then it's impossible to build a valid block upon
   309→            // it. Reject the block.
   310→            ExecutionStatus::Invalid(_) => {
   311→                return Err(BlockError::ParentExecutionPayloadInvalid {
   312→                    parent_root: parent_block.root,
   313→                });
   314→            }
   315→        };
   316→
   317→        if is_merge_transition_complete || !execution_payload.is_default_with_empty_roots() {
   318→            let expected_timestamp = chain
   319→                .slot_clock
   320→                .start_of(block.slot())
   321→                .map(|d| d.as_secs())
   322→                .ok_or(BlockError::BeaconChainError(Box::new(
   323→                    BeaconChainError::UnableToComputeTimeAtSlot,
   324→                )))?;
   325→
   326→            // The block's execution payload timestamp is correct with respect to the slot
   327→            if execution_payload.timestamp() != expected_timestamp {
   328→                return Err(BlockError::ExecutionPayloadError(
   329→                    ExecutionPayloadError::InvalidPayloadTimestamp {
   330→                        expected: expected_timestamp,
   331→                        found: execution_payload.timestamp(),
   332→                    },
   333→                ));
   334→            }
   335→        }
   336→    }
   337→
   338→    Ok(())
